VARNISH Clear Gloss.name: VARNISH Clear Gloss
VARNISH Clear Gloss.description: Transparent coating enhancing material durability and appearance with gloss or sheen.
VARNISH Clear Gloss.more_detail:
VARNISH Clear Gloss is a transparent, protective coating applied to surfaces to enhance durability and appearance. Unlike regular paint, varnish doesn't contain pigments it preserves the natural look of materials adding gloss or sheen.

Coverage: [10 to 12 square matter/1 lit]
Finish: Gloss
Drying Time: ≈ [3 to 4] hours.
Application: Brush, Roller, Spray
